data.content_ref: inline:Introduce registered attack-defeater warrants: a warrant whose carriage targets an existing attack edge (carrier->target, warrant_id), not an artifact. Compute a monotone least-fixpoint over defeater edges alone: an attack edge is removed iff it is targeted by a defeater warrant whose carrier is not itself attacked by any surviving attack edge. This pre-pass is deterministic and polynomial (O(E+V) on the defeater subgraph). Then run the standard Dung grounded extension on the surviving attack graph. This expands refutation to include undercutting and rebuttal at the level of the warrant relation, gives a causal mechanism for suspending an edge rather than merely disliking a target, and cannot invalidate a committed root because no new attack edges are ever created.
